AUDITORS’ REPORT TO THE DIRECTORS OF THE NORTHERN
We have audited the statement of financial position of the Northern Health Authority as at March 31,
2004 and the statements of operations, changes in net assets and cash flows for the year then ended.
These financial statements are the responsibility of the Authority’s management. Our responsibility is to
express an opinion on these financial statements based on our audit.
